//: Standalone tsconfig for the Live Memory plugin. The plugin's TS is transpiled at RUNTIME by the P2 loader (esbuild), NOT by the extension build — so these sources sit OUTSIDE every extension/package tsc root (root `shofer` includes only `src/`; `@shofer/core` includes only `packages/core/src`). This config exists purely so a developer/CI can typecheck the plugin against the public @shofer/types surface in isolation.
